name: Qnami
description: Qnami is a Swiss quantum sensing company spun out of the University of Basel, developing nanoscale imaging instruments based on nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond. The company commercializes quantum microscope technology for applications in nanotechnology, life science, and spintronics device characterization.

products.name: ProteusQ
products.description: Scanning NV magnetometry microscope for nanoscale magnetic imaging of spintronics devices and materials

products.name: QuantileverMX
products.description: Diamond NV-center scanning probe tips for integration into existing atomic force microscopy platforms

highlights: Spin-off from the University of Basel with pioneering NV-center quantum microscopy research
